question: Which of the following autobiographies is written by the former Indian Judge Leila Seth?

options.text: Challenges of Governance: An Insider's View
Justice for the Judge: An Autobiography
In Pursuit of Justice: An Autobiography

solution:
The Correct answer is __**On Balance: An Autobiography**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Leila Seth** was the first woman to become the **Chief Justice of a state High Court in India**, specifically the Himachal Pradesh High Court.
 
• Her autobiography, **On Balance**, provides a detailed account of her personal and professional life, highlighting her journey as a trailblazing figure in the Indian judicial system.
